create_stanford_lightfield_dataset: create a StanfordLightfieldDataset instance with config and split to load Stanford lightfield images and camera coordinates
create_stanford_epi_dataset: create a StanfordEPIDataset instance with config to load EPI images and compute su coordinate grids
create_stanford_llff_dataset: create a StanfordLLFFDataset instance with config to load LLFF-format Stanford data with poses and intrinsics
review_stanford_llff_read_meta: review the StanfordLLFFDataset read_meta method that parses camera coordinates from filenames and normalizes them
review_stanford_llff_prepare_render_data: review the StanfordLLFFDataset prepare_render_data method that creates spiral or interpolated poses for rendering
